observation: The whole page sits in a fixed content column. Content runs from x=180 to x=1260 (1080px wide) inside a 1440px viewport, with equal side gutters. Headers, grids, the hero image and the footer all share these edges.

observation: The header is a single bar 65px tall. The logo is on the left, the nav links follow it, and Login plus a pill 'Sign up' button are pushed to the right edge. A thin bottom border separates it from the hero.

observation: The hero is centred. A very large bold H1 wraps onto two lines, with a one-line subtitle and a pill-shaped search form below it. The H1 is 54.4px, weight 700, centre-aligned, in dark slate rgb(32,39,44).

observation: The hero background is a soft peach-to-white vertical gradient (the one gradient background in the facts). A full-width-of-column photo sits on top of it and fades into the gradient at its edges.

observation: The search form is a single pill. It has a dark 2px outline, a placeholder input, and a peach 'Search' button that is flush against the right end. The label is present but moved off-screen at x=-9999.

The hero photo is a wide 1440×540 lifestyle image of a mum holding a smiling baby's hand. It is scaled to 1080×405 and has soft or feathered edges with a faint rounded top. It is the only large photo above the fold, and its alt text is descriptive.
evidence: images[1] image-02.jpg natural 1440x540, rect 1080x405, alt 'A mum holding her smiling baby's hand'.

observation: The palette is restrained and built from a few colours. Dark slate (32,39,44) is the text colour and the dark section background. Peach (255,170,145) is the accent for buttons, step badges and eyebrow labels. A pale blush (255,241,236) fills tinted bands. A burnt orange-red (196,71,42) is used for numbers, links and pills.
Typography uses only a system font stack (system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif). There are no web fonts, no stylesheets and no scripts. All styling is in one inline <style> block.
evidence: fonts_by_element_count system-ui 274, Arial 2; stylesheets 0; scripts 0; tag_counts style 1.

observation: Headings are consistently heavy and tightly tracked. H2s are 33.6px bold, left-aligned, and each is followed by a short grey one-line subtitle. The heading + subtitle pattern repeats across sections.
evidence: h2 font_size 33.6px weight 700; subtitles 'Eight places to start.', 'Four simple steps.', 'What parents are reading and reviewing right now.', 'Fresh opinions from the community.'

observation: Body text is 16px on a 25.6px line height (1.6). Secondary text such as subtitles and review bylines is in mid-grey rgb(91,101,108).
evidence: body_font_size 16px, body_line_height 25.6px; grey 91,101,108 used 10 times.

observation: The category browser uses emoji as icons, not SVG or image icons. Eight white cards with a hairline border and rounded corners each hold a centred emoji above a bold label. They fill a six-column row, and the last two cards are left-aligned on the next row, leaving empty space on the right.

observation: Rounded corners are used almost everywhere. Cards sit in the 8–15px and 16px+ radius buckets. Buttons are fully rounded pills. No box-shadows are used, so depth comes from 1px borders and background tints.

observation: The page uses native semantic landmarks: one header, one nav, one main, seven sections each with an h2, four articles, and one footer. There is exactly one H1, and the outline runs h1 → h2 → h3 without skipping levels. There are no aside, figure or blockquote elements.

observation: The page is a long single scroll (6029px) of alternating background bands: white, blush, white, white, dark slate, white. Each band is a full-width section with generous vertical padding of roughly 64px above the h2. Dark and tinted bands mark the major content breaks.

observation: The copy is plain and friendly, written in Australian English. Examples are 'mum', 'dummies', 'prams', 'Moisturiser' and 'Steriliser'.
